info.title: Aurora IR Web API
info.description:
REST API of **Aurora IR Web**, a multi-user web edition of
[Aurora Incident Response](https://github.com/cyb3rfox/Aurora-Incident-Response).

* Authenticate programs with an application API key: `Authorization: Bearer aurora_...`
  (administrators create keys under *Administration → API Keys*; profile `read` or `readwrite`).
* All times are UTC. All writes are validated and referentially checked.
* Full documentation: `docs/api.md` in the repository.

get.summary: List users (by username)

post.summary: Create a user

patch.summary: Change role, active, investigator, password, forced password change or IP allowlist
patch.description: A password reset or deactivation signs the user out everywhere.

post.summary: Remove a user's MFA (they enrol again; required at next sign-in when MFA is enforced)

get.summary: List cases (newest Case ID first)
get.description:
Ordered by Case ID descending, comparing numbers naturally (IR-609 before IR-608). A user sees only the
cases they own or were invited to; an administrator (or an all-scope key) sees every case.

parameters.name: q

schema.description: filter on Case ID or client (case-insensitive)
schema.title: Q

parameters.description: filter on Case ID or client (case-insensitive)

post.summary: Create an empty case (you become its owner)
Import a .fox file as a new case (you become its owner)
post.description:
Request body: the raw .fox JSON. `declare_missing=true` auto-creates referenced but undeclared
systems/investigators/malware and lookup values instead of rejecting the file. Importing a .fox is the
equivalent of creating and populating a case, so the importer becomes its owner.

post.summary: Replace all data of a case from a .fox (owner/admin; a database snapshot is written first)
Delete a case (owner/admin; a database snapshot is written first)

get.summary: Case details, revision and per-section counts
List the users with access to a case (owner/admin)

post.summary: Add a user to a case directly (administrator only; owners use invite codes)

delete.summary: Remove a member from a case (owner/admin)

post.summary: Leave a case you are a member of

get.summary: List a case's invite codes (owner/admin)

post.summary: Create an invite code for a case (owner/admin; the code is shown only once)
Join a case with its id (uuid) and an invite code
post.description:
A signed-in user adds themselves to a case using the case uuid and an invite code shared offline by the
owner. The permission (editor/viewer) is the one the owner set on the invite.

get.summary: Change counter (poll this to detect changes)
Allowed values: lookup lists and reference names
Download the case as an Aurora .fox file
Download the case as an Excel workbook (SOD)
get.description:
The "spreadsheet of doom": a Cover sheet (application, logo, case presentation, who exported it and when,
case metadata), a Report sheet (executive summary, context, conclusions, lessons learned), then one sheet per section in the default order. Built from the
same verified snapshot as the .fox. Times are UTC; text is never stored as formulas (formula-injection
safe); MISP/VirusTotal API keys are not included.

get.summary: Download the case as a PDF report
get.description:
Cover, executive summary, the Visual Timeline / Lateral Movement / Activity Plot charts and every section
as a table (A4 landscape).

get.summary: Download the case as a LaTeX report (.tex)
get.description:
The same content as the PDF as one self-contained .tex file (charts drawn with TikZ / pgfplots). Compile
with `xelatex`. All case text is escaped.

get.summary: Report page (executive summary, context, conclusions, lessons learned)
get.description:
`executive_summary`, `conclusions` and `lessons_learned` are never written to the .fox; `context` is the
case's Summary field (exported to the .fox as one line). Multi-line text is allowed in all four.

patch.description:
Recorded in the activity log (`update_report`). With `expected`, a field changed meanwhile by someone
else returns 409 with the current values.

get.summary: Activity log (newest first)
Full-text search across sections
Incident summary (figures behind the reports)
Snapshot used by the reporting views
get.description: Read-only snapshot for the reporting views. Never writes (no audit entry, no export).

get.summary: List / filter / page records
get.description:
Without `sort`, records come in the section's default order (`default_order` in /api/schema, e.g. the
timeline newest first). `total` is the count before paging.

parameters.name: q

schema.description: case-insensitive text search over all fields
schema.title: Q

parameters.description: case-insensitive text search over all fields

post.summary: Create a record
post.description:
`declare_missing=true`: referenced systems / investigators / malware that do not exist yet are
created (name only) instead of failing with 422.

get.summary: Export a section's records as CSV (RFC 4180, UTF-8)

post.summary: Import records into a section from a validated CSV (all-or-nothing)
post.description:
Request body: raw CSV (RFC 4180, UTF-8). The header names the columns (a section's editable fields);
every cell is validated like the API / .fox import and the whole file is rejected if any value is invalid.

get.summary: Get one record

patch.description:
Send `changes` plus either `version` (fails with 409 if anyone changed the record since you read it) or
`expected` (field-level merge: fails only if someone changed the *same* fields).

parameters.name: version

schema.description: fail with 409 if the record changed
schema.title: Version

parameters.description: fail with 409 if the record changed

post.summary: Create many records atomically
post.description: All or nothing: if any record is invalid, nothing is written and the error carries its `index`.

post.summary: Delete a record (POST alias used by the web UI)

get.summary: Which integrations are configured (never returns the API keys)

post.summary: Test the MISP connection with the case's server, API key and event
Test the VirusTotal API key of the case

get.summary: Row actions available for a record (and why an action is unavailable)

post.summary: Add a timeline event from an investigated system, malware or exfiltration record
post.description:
Field mapping as in Aurora: investigated system → first compromise + summary; malware → creation date,
"Malware created (path)"; exfiltration → exfil time, staging system → destination, type Exfil.
The new event has *Followup* ticked. Returns the created timeline record.

post.summary: Add the host of a malware record to Investigated Systems (Aurora's 'To hosts')
post.description: Refused (409) if the host is already listed in Investigated Systems.

get.summary: MISP attributes proposed for a malware or network-indicator record

post.summary: Send attributes of a record to the case's MISP event
post.description:
The server calls `POST <MISP server>/attributes/add/<event id>` with the case's MISP API key. Values must
come from `misp-attributes`; type and comment may be changed. Recorded in the activity log.

post.summary: Look up the hash of a malware record on VirusTotal and store the verdict in 'vt'
post.description:
Verdict: `infected` (at least one engine flags it), `clean`, or `noresult` (unknown to VirusTotal).
Requires a hash in the record and a VirusTotal API key in Case Details.

expected.title: Expected
expected.description: field -> value you started from (field-level merge)

version.title: Version
version.description: record version you read (whole-record lock); alternative to expected

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: Must equal the case's Case ID

permission.title: Permission
permission.description: what redeemers get: editor (view + change) or viewer (read-only)

max_redeems.title: Max Redeems
max_redeems.description: how many users may use it; 0 = unlimited

expires.title: Expires
expires.description: last valid day, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC); null = never

uuid.title: Uuid
uuid.description: the case's id (uuid) shared by the owner

code.title: Code
code.description: the invite code shared by the owner

expected.title: Expected
expected.description: omit to overwrite without conflict detection

type.title: Type
type.description: MISP attribute type, e.g. ip-dst, domain, md5

value.title: Value
value.description: one of the values proposed by GET .../misp-attributes

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: omit to send every proposed attribute

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: the user to make owner (owner: a current member; admin: any active user)

expected.title: Expected
expected.description: values you started from (field-level merge); omit to overwrite

must_change_password.title: Must Change Password
must_change_password.description: the user must choose a new password at first sign-in

must_change_password.title: Must Change Password
must_change_password.description: force a new password at next sign-in

ip_allowlist.title: Ip Allowlist
ip_allowlist.description: IPv4/IPv6 addresses or CIDR ranges; empty = any address
